name: TabFlow
tagline: Search, archive and save your tabs
summary: Side panel tab manager. Search open and archived tabs, archive idle tabs on a timer, and save tab sets to reopen later.

name: Ghost Mode
tagline: One-click history blackout that keeps you signed in
summary: Start a ghost session, browse as usual, then erase that session's history and download records. Cookies and logins stay.

name: Queue for Claude
tagline: Queue your next messages on claude.ai
summary: Queue follow-up messages on claude.ai. Each one is sent automatically when Claude finishes the reply before it.

name: ChatBridge
tagline: One library for your AI chats, kept in your browser
summary: Search, tag, and organize your ChatGPT and Claude chats. 100% local. Nothing leaves your machine.

name: AngleCheck
tagline: Compare how outlets frame a story
summary: See how other outlets cover the news story you are reading: their framing, tone, and the points your article left out.

name: CleanCritique
tagline: Capture, mark up and share site critiques
summary: Capture and mark up any page across a site or social property, then bundle every capture into one named, shareable critique project.
